title: Rory and the Glowing Cavern
verses:
When shadows grew long in the valley of green,
Then Rory walked slowly to finish the day.
And Nia swooped down through the moonlight serene,
To guide all her friends on a quiet pathway.

She led them inside a deep cavern of stone,
Where blue moss was shining with quiet soft light.
Where nobody ever felt lost or alone,
Protected and warm from the chilly dark night.

Then Benny lay down near a warm thermal spring,
And Ricky stopped bouncing to give a huge yawn.
While Nia tucked neatly her head under wing,
Prepared for a sleep that would last until dawn.

Then Tilly smoothed moss for a velvet-soft bed,
And gathered rich blossom petals nearby.
While Psittaco nestled right near Rory's head,
To watch the sweet stars in the quiet dark sky.

Then Rory relaxed with a satisfied sigh,
As soothing warm shadows wrapped gently around.
A slow lullaby drifted down from the sky,
And hummed a sweet tune to the slumbering ground.

The cavern was silent, the nighttime was deep,
The dinos were rested and snug in their nest.
Together they settled in magical sleep,
Embraced by the peaceful and beautiful rest.
